appraisal_events.evidence: « Il était si puissant, si en faveur auprès des gens en place... persuadé que mon père avait trop d'intelligences avec les puissances suprêmes, de trop irrésistibles lettres de recommandation auprès du bon Dieu »
appraisal_events.explanation: The child-narrator's admiring, hyperbolic account of his father's social power (bending administrative rules, near-divine influence) elevates him, but the adult narrator's retrospective framing of this as childish magical thinking introduces gentle irony.

status_effects.explanation: Locally elevated through the child's admiring depiction of his influence and near-omnipotent social standing, tempered by the irony of the retrospective frame.
